# Hotel & Restaurant Coroana — Războieni, Iași, Romania

> Hotel, restaurant and the largest events venue in the Moldova region of Romania,
> at km 31 on the Iași – Târgu Frumos road (DN28), 705311 Războieni, Iași county.

## Key facts (verified)
- 43 modern rooms
- Google rating: 4.5★ from 2,348 reviews
- Free Wi-Fi, free private parking (300 spaces), room service, terraces
- Restaurant with Romanian cuisine — guests praise the taste, fast service and fair prices
- Coroana Events: 4 halls — Prestige (400–600), Moonlight (200–350), Celeste (100–180),
  Serenity (up to 50) — up to 1,000 guests in total; weddings, christenings, conferences,
  corporate events

## Room rates (per night, may vary by period)
- Wing A: matrimonial room 290 lei (single occupancy) / 350 lei (double), twin room 290 lei, single room 240 lei, triple room 390 lei
- Wing B: twin room 290 lei, single room 240 lei, triple room 360 lei; 2★ category: twin 200 lei, single 150 lei

## Contact
- Hotel reception: +40 232 711 500 / +40 755 081 783 · receptie@hotelcoroana.ro
- Events department: +40 786 298 932 · events@hotelcoroana.ro
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/XToMctMBVkWNofkR9
